item.title: Statement on the US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 Announcements Jun 12, 2026 The US government has issued an export control directive to suspend all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5.

Announcements Jun 11, 2026 Introducing Claude Corps We’re launching Claude Corps, a national fellowship program for people early in their careers who are passionate about extending the benefits of AI to communities across America.
Announcements Jun 2, 2026 Expanding Project Glasswing We’re extending Project Glasswing to approximately 150 new organizations in more than fifteen countries.
